title: Worktree sweeps treat board-only leftovers as nothing to keep
notes: 2026-11-24: 5 worktrees sat in dashboard.worktrees/ since Nov 16 and no sweep took them. Two held only an uncommitted edit of their own .dashboard/board/cards/<id>.json (PRs #282, #285 merged); two held only an unpushed 'board: ship "…"' commit touching only .dashboard/board/; one was a detached HEAD already on origin/main. worktree.sweep (throwaways) and the leftover sweep (#347) keep anything with uncommitted changes or commits no remote has. Count a change or commit that touches only .dashboard/board/ as nothing to keep (the board lives on the default branch, so the card file in a worktree is a stale copy), in the one predicate both sweeps use, with a test for each of the three cases. Keep refusing a locked worktree or one a pane still uses.

comments.body: From main, 2026-11-26: dirty and pushed count any change or unpushed commit (leftover-sweep.ts:55,58; leftover-worktrees.ts:59); nothing exempts .dashboard/board/. blockingChanges (ship/ship.ts:119) already exempts .dashboard/ for the change check; the unpushed board-only commit case needs a new check. Five such worktrees have sat in dashboard.worktrees/ since Nov 16.
Pull request #393 opened: Worktree sweeps treat board-only leftovers as nothing to keep https://github.com/naeemba/dashboard/pull/393

Review loop converged, ready to merge. 2 rounds, 6 findings fixed, 0 rejected, nothing open. Round 1 (e563dbbb): removals ask git status with --untracked-files=normal, so the board-only force never takes untracked files a showUntrackedFiles=no config hid; removalChanges reuses workChanges; errors-rule-1 doc names both predicates. Round 2 (f828feae, d3b6eca0): one exported status argument list in ship.ts for all four callers; a test pins the untracked flag. The final check accepted both. No conflicts. CI passed on d3b6eca0. Scope and design unchanged.
